topic.label: Commodities
topic.desc: Raw materials that trade: energy, metals and agriculture, physical and futures markets, and supply and demand drivers.

concepts: Crude oil, natural gas, refined products and power, benchmarks such as WTI and Brent.
Precious and industrial metals: gold, silver, copper, aluminum and their markets.
Grains, softs and livestock: corn, wheat, soybeans, coffee, sugar, cattle, seasonality and crop reports.
Physical delivery, storage, transport, grades and how physical and futures prices connect.
skills: Summarizes crude oil supply, demand, inventories and the benchmark spread.
Explains what drives a metal's price: industrial demand, safe haven flows, currency and supply.
Reads a crop report and explains its effect on supply and prices.
Explains basis between a physical location and the futures price.
